nemotron.prompt: Audio transcription. Language: Arabic. Wording: verbatim, including fillers and repetitions. Formatting: punctuation and capitalization. Output: transcript only.
nemotron.reading: LM log-likelihood of the text as the reply to the transcription request, plain spellings (core.plain_candidates against its own label-blind transcript), best spelling per text

fastconformer.reading: CTC forced-alignment log-likelihood, diacritised spellings (core.diacritised_candidates against its own label-blind CTC greedy text and RNNT transcript), best spelling per text
